methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: a novel method for assessing the quality of energy management in the form of an energy management system sustainability index (EnMS SI) framework

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper develops a qualitative EnMS sustainability-assessment index/framework (AHP indicator weighting + weighted arithmetic mean over 30 management-practice indicators scored 1-3), validated across 31 ISO 50001-certified companies. It is an assessment tool/framework, not an EnPI/EnB measurement model; EnPI/EnB appear only incidentally (one of 30 indicators; ISO 50006 citation).

paper_type.evidence_quote: The EnMS SI framework is a tool for assessing energy management sustainability

stage1.notes: EnMS SI is an AHP+WAM qualitative decision-support/composite index of EnMS 'sustainability', not an EnPI/EnB energy-performance model; typed as maturity model or framework (qualitative assessment tool).
